mapper.select: SELECT id, entered as entryTime, fullpath, dateupdated, systemname, coalesce(decCount, 0) as decCount, fileDate, dateUpdated from roster r LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT d.rosterId AS rosterEntry, COUNT(*) AS decCount FROM decoder d GROUP BY rosterId) ON r.id = rosterEntry order by systemname
